source.identity: Quan Geng, Pramod Viswanath, Optimal Noise Adding Mechanisms for Approximate Differential Privacy, arXiv:1305.1330v3 [cs.DS] 19 Dec 2013 (HTML reader)
source.manifest_match: equal to manifest P_GV_APPROX13 (1546 LF, logical extent 1547, 175009 B)

what_it_states: Integer-valued noise (Z and Z^d), global sensitivity in the l1 metric, (epsilon,delta)-DP including (0,delta) and (epsilon,0) as special cases, expected cost for symmetric nondecreasing costs, with l1 (|.|, ||.||_1) and l2 (squared, ||.||_2^2) costs emphasized. Scalar: Theorem 1 (exact) uniform noise optimal for (0,delta), Delta=1; Theorem 2 relaxed-LP lower bound for (0,delta), Delta>=2 under condition (28); Theorem 3 uniform upper bound; Corollaries 4-7 gaps (Corollary 5: for squared cost the ratio tends to 1 as delta->0); Theorem 8 relaxed-LP lower bound for (epsilon,delta) under condition (61) with a dual certificate (Appendix D); Theorems 9-10 / Corollary 11 uniform and discrete-Laplace upper bounds; Corollaries 12-15 constant-factor ratios as (epsilon,delta)->(0,0). Multi-dimensional Z^d with ||v||_1 <= Delta: lower bounds use only coordinate-axis shifts v = Delta e_m and half-space sets; Theorems 16-17 (0,delta) lower bounds; Theorem 18 / Corollaries 19-24 uniform upper bounds, exact optimality of the multi-dimensional uniform noise for (0,delta), Delta=1 with l1 and squared-l2 costs (Corollaries 22, 24); Theorems 25-26 asymptotic constant-factor lower bounds with beta = max(epsilon,delta) -> 0 (log(9/8) d Delta/beta for l1; 0.0177 d Delta^2/beta^2 for squared l2); Corollaries 27-28 constant-factor sandwiches (8.49, 113). Cites [4] Geng-Viswanath multidimensional-setting preprint (Dec 2013) for multidimensional staircase optimality (citation only; not opened under this direction).
what_it_does_not_state: No exact optimum for pure epsilon-DP in dimension >= 2 (pure-DP multidimensional content is only the beta->0 constant-factor lower bound plus Laplace upper bound on the lattice Z^d); no continuous-output (R^2) statement; no finite-epsilon exact all-law MSE value or selector for the planar l1 diamond; no staircase/diamond/rounded-core selector; no mixed-cost all-law bound E||Z||_2^2 >= (2/3) inf E||Z||_1^2; the relaxed LPs drop all non-axis shifts and all non-half-space sets, so their lower bounds are relaxation values, not optimal values for the full constraint.
